_readme: One entry per location page. Only verified values enter the markup. The FAQ is deliberately empty: it must be transcribed from each live page, not written here.
_faqInstructions: FAQPage markup must mirror Q&A that is visibly published on the page. Copy each page's real questions and answers into its `faq` array as [{"question": "...", "answer": "..."}], word for word as published, then re-run generate-locations.py. A page whose `faq` array is empty emits a plain WebPage with no FAQPage type and no mainEntity — which is correct, not a gap. Do not paraphrase the page copy; if the markup and the page disagree, the markup is wrong. (Note: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 7 May 2026, so this earns no SERP snippet. Its value is entity clarity and extraction by AI answer engines.)
_priceInstructions: `priceFrom` is empty for every location. The $495 entry price is published on the four metro pages; whether it is stated on these 16 pages is unverified. Set `priceFrom` per location only where the page actually publishes a price, and an Offer will be emitted.
_descriptionNote: The WebPage and Service descriptions are generated from the city, the state and BINM's verified positioning (engineer-led, Chartered Engineers and Licensed Builders, one inspection covering every report level). They are not transcribed from the live pages. Check them against each page's real meta description and on-page copy before publishing.
_referenceNote: The `_reference` block on each entry is background for whoever collects the FAQ copy: the state building regulator and the tribunal that hears building disputes in that state. These are factual jurisdiction details and do NOT enter the markup. The BINM_Location_Pages sheet also carries a Tribunal / Dispute Path and Local Hook column per city.
